pokedex.758: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.
pokedex.759: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.
pokedex.760: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.
pokedex.761: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.
pokedex.762: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.
pokedex.763: Its long, striking legs aren’t just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.
pokedex.764: It attaches flowers to its highly nutritious vine. This revitalizes the flowers, and they give off an aromatic scent.
pokedex.765: Known for its extreme intelligence, this Pokémon will look down on inexperienced Trainers, so it’s best suited to veteran Trainers.
pokedex.766: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.
pokedex.767: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.
pokedex.768: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.
pokedex.769: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.
pokedex.770: Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.
pokedex.771: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. It can eject its internal organs, which it uses to engulf its prey or battle enemies.
pokedex.772: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some hidden special power.
pokedex.773: Its trust in its partner is what awakens it. This Pokémon is capable of changing its type, a flexibility that is well displayed in battle.
pokedex.774: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing its body grows too heavy.
pokedex.775: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.
pokedex.776: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.
pokedex.777: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.
pokedex.778: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.
pokedex.779: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.
pokedex.780: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.
pokedex.781: Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.
pokedex.782: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.
pokedex.783: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.
pokedex.784: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.
pokedex.785: This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming with curiosity. It summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.
pokedex.786: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of its energy.
pokedex.787: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around. It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth.
pokedex.788: The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies. Ocean currents are the source of its energy.
pokedex.789: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.
pokedex.790: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.
pokedex.791: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.
pokedex.792: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.
pokedex.793: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. People on the street report observing those infested by it suddenly becoming violent.
pokedex.794: This Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.
pokedex.795: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it has been spotted running across the land at terrific speeds.
pokedex.796: One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate from its entire body, according to witnesses.
pokedex.797: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. Witnesses observed it flying across the sky at high speed.
pokedex.798: This Ultra Beast came from the Ultra Wormhole. It seems not to attack enemies on its own, but its sharp body is a dangerous weapon in itself.
pokedex.799: It has gobbled mountains and swallowed whole buildings, according to reports. It’s one of the Ultra Beasts.
pokedex.800: Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this life-form, apparently asleep underground, is thought to have come from another world in ancient times.
pokedex.801: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.
pokedex.802: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.

moves.teleport: Use it to flee from any wild Pokémon.
moves.waterfall: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch.
moves.razor-wind: In this two-turn attack, blades of wind hit opposing Pokémon on the second turn. Critical hits land more easily.
moves.skull-bash: The user tucks in its head to raise its Defense stat on the first turn, then rams the target on the next turn.
moves.constrict: The target is attacked with long, creeping tentacles, vines, or the like. This may also lower the target’s Speed stat.
moves.soft-boiled: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its max HP.
moves.poison-gas: A cloud of poison gas is sprayed in the face of opposing Pokémon, poisoning those hit.
moves.bubble: A spray of countless bubbles is jetted at the opposing Pokémon. This may also lower their Speed stat.
moves.cut: The target is cut with a scythe or claw.
moves.bonemerang: The user throws the bone it holds. The bone loops around to hit the target twice—coming and going.
moves.sharpen: The user makes its edges more jagged, which raises its Attack stat.
moves.tri-attack: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. May also burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.
moves.snore: This attack can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.
moves.cotton-spore: The user releases cotton-like spores that cling to the opposing Pokémon, which harshly lowers their Speed stat.
moves.fly: The user soars and then strikes its target on the next turn.
moves.destiny-bond: After using this move, if the user faints, the Pokémon that landed the knockout hit also faints. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
moves.sandstorm: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except the Rock, Ground, and Steel types. It raises the Sp. Def stat of Rock types.
moves.milk-drink: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its max HP.
moves.return: This full-power attack grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.
moves.frustration: This full-power attack grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.
moves.encore: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.
moves.pursuit: The power of this attack move is doubled if it’s used on a target that’s switching out of battle.
moves.sweet-scent: A sweet scent that harshly lowers opposing Pokémon’s evasiveness.
moves.rain-dance: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves. It lowers the power of Fire-type moves.
moves.sunny-day: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves. It lowers the power of Water-type moves.
moves.rock-smash: The user attacks with a punch. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.
moves.fake-out: This attack hits first and makes the target flinch. It only works the first turn the user is in battle.
moves.uproar: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.
moves.facade: This attack move doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.
moves.smelling-salts: This attack’s power is doubled when used on a target with paralysis. This also cures the target’s paralysis, however.
moves.nature-power: This attack makes use of nature’s power. Its effects vary depending on the user’s environment.
moves.wish: One turn after this move is used, the user’s or its replacement’s HP is restored by half the user’s max HP.
moves.assist: The user hurriedly and randomly uses a move among those known by ally Pokémon.
moves.ingrain: The user lays roots that restore its HP on every turn. Because it’s rooted, it can’t switch out.
moves.revenge: This attack move’s power is doubled if the user has been hurt by the opponent in the same turn.
moves.endeavor: This attack move cuts down the target’s HP to equal the user’s HP.
moves.refresh: The user rests to cure itself of poisoning, a burn, or paralysis.
moves.secret-power: The additional effects of this attack depend upon where it was used.
moves.mud-sport: The user kicks up mud on the battlefield. This weakens Electric-type moves for five turns.
moves.ice-ball: The user attacks the target for five turns. The move’s power increases each time it hits.
moves.weather-ball: This attack move varies in power and type depending on the weather.
moves.silver-wind: The target is attacked with powdery scales blown by the wind. This may also raise all the user’s stats.
moves.sheer-cold: The target faints instantly. It’s less likely to hit the target if it’s used by Pokémon other than Ice types.
moves.dragon-claw: The user slashes the target with huge sharp claws.
moves.volt-tackle: The user electrifies itself and charges the target. This also damages the user quite a lot. This attack may leave the target with paralysis.
moves.water-sport: The user soaks the battlefield with water. This weakens Fire-type moves for five turns.
moves.wrap: A long body, vines, or the like are used to wrap and squeeze the target for four to five turns.
moves.doom-desire: Two turns after this move is used, a concentrated bundle of light blasts the target.
moves.gravity: Enables Flying-type Pokémon or Pokémon with the Levitate Ability to be hit by Ground-type moves. Flying moves can’t be used.
moves.hammer-arm: The user swings and hits with its strong, heavy fist. It lowers the user’s Speed, however.
moves.feint: This attack hits a target using a move such as Protect or Detect. This also lifts the effects of those moves.
moves.metal-burst: The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.
moves.embargo: This move prevents the target from using its held item for five turns. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.
moves.power-trick: The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack stat with its Defense stat.
moves.lucky-chant: The user chants an incantation toward the sky, preventing opposing Pokémon from landing critical hits for five turns.
